ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus Operation DreamJob — signed-binary DLL sideload from user-writable path
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus / Diamond Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima job-lure chain (LinkedIn DreamJob, Gotta Fly UAV-sector campaigns) where a trojanized ISO/IMG/ZIP drops a legitimate signed Windows or third-party binary (Tableau, FortiClient, VLC, PuTTY ssh-agent, CameraSettingsUIHost, ApplicationFrameHost, wsmprovhost, colorcpl) into %USERPROFILE%/Downloads/Temp and that binary then loads a co-located attacker DLL. The signed-binary-in-user-path + side-by-side .dll combination is the DreamJob signature.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("CameraSettingsUIHost.exe","ApplicationFrameHost.exe","FortiSSLVPNclient.exe","FortiClient.exe","Tableau.exe","vlc.exe","wsmprovhost.exe","ssh.exe","ssh-agent.exe","colorcpl.exe","wermgr.exe","mscoree.exe","CompMgmtLauncher.exe","StikyNot.exe","msdtc.exe") (Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Downloads\\*") Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","forfiles.exe","rundll32.exe","7zFM.exe","WinRAR.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=left host process_path [ | tstats `summariesonly` values(Filesystem.file_name) as colocated_dlls from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" by host Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | eval process_path=file_path | fields host process_path colocated_dlls ] | where isnotnull(colocated_dlls) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let SideloadedBinaries = dynamic(["camerasettingsuihost.exe","applicationframehost.exe","wsmprovhost.exe","colorcpl.exe","fortisslvpnclient.exe","forticlient.exe","tableau.exe","vlc.exe","ssh.exe","ssh-agent.exe","stikynot.exe","wermgr.exe","compmgmtlauncher.exe","mscoree.exe","msdtc.exe"]);
let UserPaths = dynamic(["\\users\\","\\downloads\\","\\desktop\\","\\documents\\","\\appdata\\local\\temp\\","\\programdata\\","\\public\\"]);
let KnownSystemDlls = dynamic(["kernel32.dll","ntdll.dll","user32.dll","msvcrt.dll","msvcp140.dll","vcruntime140.dll","combase.dll","advapi32.dll","ole32.dll","shell32.dll"]);
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) in (SideloadedBinaries)
| where tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath) has_any (UserPaths)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where tolower(FileName) !in (KnownSystemDlls)
| extend BinaryDir = tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath), DllDir = tolower(FolderPath)
| where BinaryDir == DllDir                              // co-located DLL == sideload
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          SideloadedBinary=InitiatingProcessFileName,
          BinaryPath=InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          LoadedDll=FileName, DllSHA256=SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SideloadedBinaries = dynamic(["camerasettingsuihost.exe","applicationframehost.exe","wsmprovhost.exe","colorcpl.exe","fortisslvpnclient.exe","forticlient.exe","tableau.exe","vlc.exe","ssh.exe","ssh-agent.exe","stikynot.exe","wermgr.exe","compmgmtlauncher.exe","mscoree.exe"]);
let UserPaths = dynamic(["\\users\\","\\downloads\\","\\appdata\\local\\temp\\","\\programdata\\","\\public\\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend BinaryName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where BinaryName in (SideloadedBinaries)
| where tolower(NewProcessName) has_any (UserPaths)
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","forfiles.exe","rundll32.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\CameraSettingsUIHost.exe OR *\\camerasettingsuihost.exe OR *\\ApplicationFrameHost.exe OR *\\applicationframehost.exe OR *\\FortiSSLVPNclient.exe OR *\\fortisslvpnclient.exe OR *\\FortiClient.exe OR *\\Tableau.exe OR *\\tableau.exe OR *\\vlc.exe OR *\\VLC.exe OR *\\wsmprovhost.exe OR *\\colorcpl.exe OR *\\ssh.exe OR *\\ssh-agent.exe OR *\\StikyNot.exe OR *\\stikynot.exe OR *\\wermgr.exe OR *\\mscoree.exe) (@Image:(*\\Users\\* OR *\\users\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\downloads\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\appdata\\local\\temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\Public\\*)) @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\7zFM.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\winrar.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(CameraSettingsUIHost|ApplicationFrameHost|FortiSSLVPNclient|FortiClient|Tableau|vlc|wsmprovhost|colorcpl|ssh|ssh-agent|StikyNot|wermgr|CompMgmtLauncher|mscoree|msdtc)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(Users|Downloads|Desktop|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|ProgramData|Public)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| ParentBaseFileName=/(explorer|cmd|powershell|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|7zFM|WinRAR)\.exe/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: DreamJob is Lazarus's signature initial-access chain (Mandiant UNC2970, Microsoft Diamond Sleet, ESET 'Gotta Fly'). Every documented variant since 2020 — Operation In(ter)ception, Operation DreamJob, ZetaNile, the 2024 UAV-sector campaign — uses the same recipe: ISO/IMG container delivering a benign-looking lure + a *legitimately signed* Windows or third-party binary + a sideloaded malicious DLL c

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus FudModule BYOVD — known-vulnerable signed driver dropped by non-installer process
ucs.description: Detects Lazarus's hallmark Bring-Your-Own-Vulnerable-Driver (BYOVD) tradecraft used by the FudModule rootkit to disable EDR/AV via Direct Kernel Object Manipulation. Watches for the file-write of any of the ~15 signed-but-vulnerable drivers Lazarus has been observed dropping (ene.sys, dbutil_2_3.sys, RTCore64.sys, mhyprot2.sys, AswArPot.sys, etc.) when the dropping process is not a legitimate Windows installer.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as drop_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("ene.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","RTCore64.sys","mhyprot2.sys","viragt64.sys","AswArPot.sys","gdrv.sys","ZAM_Guard.sys","ucorewin.sys","wnbios.sys","procexp152.sys","ntiolib.sys","Truesight.sys","atillk64.sys","msio64.sys","speedfan.sys","cpuz141.sys") Filesystem.action="created" by host Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | search NOT process_name IN ("TrustedInstaller.exe","MsMpEng.exe","msiexec.exe","setup.exe","wuauclt.exe","CcmExec.exe","TiWorker.exe") NOT process_path="*\\Windows\\System32\\*" | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let VulnerableDrivers = dynamic(["ene.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","rtcore64.sys","mhyprot2.sys","viragt64.sys","aswarpot.sys","gdrv.sys","zam_guard.sys","ucorewin.sys","wnbios.sys","procexp152.sys","ntiolib.sys","truesight.sys","atillk64.sys","msio64.sys","speedfan.sys","cpuz141.sys"]);
let TrustedDroppers = dynamic(["trustedinstaller.exe","msmpeng.exe","msiexec.exe","setup.exe","wuauclt.exe","ccmexec.exe","tiworker.exe"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileModified")
| where tolower(FileName) in (VulnerableDrivers)
| where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) !in (TrustedDroppers)
| where not(InitiatingProcessFolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\System32")
| where not(InitiatingProcessFolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\WinSxS")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any ("\\Users\\","\\Temp\\","\\ProgramData\\","\\Public\\")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          DroppedDriver=FileName, DropPath=FolderPath, DriverSHA256=SHA256,
          DropperProcess=InitiatingProcessFileName,
          DropperPath=InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          DropperCmdLine=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          DropperSHA256=InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let VulnerableDrivers = dynamic(["ene.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","rtcore64.sys","mhyprot2.sys","viragt64.sys","aswarpot.sys","gdrv.sys","zam_guard.sys","ucorewin.sys","wnbios.sys","procexp152.sys","ntiolib.sys","truesight.sys","atillk64.sys","msio64.sys","speedfan.sys","cpuz141.sys"]);
let TrustedDroppers = dynamic(["trustedinstaller.exe","msmpeng.exe","msiexec.exe","setup.exe","wuauclt.exe","tiworker.exe"]);
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated", "FileModified")
| extend FileLower = tolower(TargetFileName)
| where FileLower in (VulnerableDrivers)
| extend ProcLower = tolower(ActingProcessName)
| where ProcLower !in (TrustedDroppers)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          DroppedDriver=TargetFileName, DropPath=TargetFilePath,
          DriverSHA256=TargetFileSHA256,
          DropperProcess=ActingProcessName,
          DropperCmdLine=ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus FudModule BYOVD - Known-Vulnerable Signed Driver Dropped to Disk
id: 8b4f2a1e-7d3c-4f5a-9b1e-2c4d6e8a3f5b
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of known-vulnerable signed kernel drivers abused by Lazarus Group (G0032 / Diamond Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima) FudModule rootkit and related BYOVD chains to disable EDR/AV via DKOM. Maps to MITRE T1068 + T1014.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2022/10/26/looking-back-at-byovd-attacks/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/lazarus-luring-employees-trojanized-coding-challenges/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1014
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.g0032
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_driver:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\ene.sys'
      - '\dbutil_2_3.sys'
      - '\RTCore64.sys'
      - '\mhyprot2.sys'
      - '\viragt64.sys'
      - '\AswArPot.sys'
      - '\gdrv.sys'
      - '\ZAM_Guard.sys'
      - '\ucorewin.sys'
      - '\wnbios.sys'
      - '\procexp152.sys'
      - '\ntiolib.sys'
      - '\Truesight.sys'
      - '\atillk64.sys'
      - '\msio64.sys'
      - '\speedfan.sys'
      - '\cpuz141.sys'
  filter_installers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\MsMpEng.exe'
      - '\wuauclt.exe'
      - '\TiWorker.exe'
      - '\CcmExec.exe'
  filter_winsxs:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
      - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\'
  condition: selection_driver and not (filter_installers or filter_winsxs)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate first-time installation of MSI Afterburner, CPU-Z, SpeedFan or similar hardware-monitoring utilities by IT
  - Driver-update tools (DriverPack, Snappy Driver Installer)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\ene.sys OR *\\Ene.sys OR *\\dbutil_2_3.sys OR *\\DBUtil_2_3.sys OR *\\RTCore64.sys OR *\\rtcore64.sys OR *\\mhyprot2.sys OR *\\Mhyprot2.sys OR *\\viragt64.sys OR *\\AswArPot.sys OR *\\aswarpot.sys OR *\\gdrv.sys OR *\\ZAM_Guard.sys OR *\\zam_guard.sys OR *\\wnbios.sys OR *\\procexp152.sys OR *\\Truesight.sys OR *\\truesight.sys OR *\\atillk64.sys OR *\\msio64.sys OR *\\speedfan.sys OR *\\cpuz141.sys OR *\\ucorewin.sys) -@Image:(*\\TrustedInstaller.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsMpEng.exe OR *\\wuauclt.exe OR *\\TiWorker.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\\(ene|dbutil_2_3|RTCore64|mhyprot2|viragt64|AswArPot|gdrv|ZAM_Guard|wnbios|procexp152|Truesight|atillk64|msio64|speedfan|cpuz141|ucorewin|ntiolib)\.sys$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(MsMpEng|TrustedInstaller|msiexec|wuauclt|TiWorker|CcmExec)\.exe$/i
| NOT regex("\\\\Windows\\\\(System32|WinSxS)\\\\", field=ContextImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: BYOVD via FudModule is the most distinctive, persistently-used Lazarus capability documented since Avast / ESET / Microsoft began tracking it in 2022. Lazarus reuses the same small palette of vulnerable drivers across campaigns (ene.sys from ENE Technology, Dell dbutil_2_3.sys, MSI RTCore64.sys, miHoYo mhyprot2.sys) because each gives them a known SMM/kernel-mode primitive for DKOM-based EDR evasi
